---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for ClinicCloud
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]" or "Healthcare professionals need [...]"

## 🚀 Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen and how it would work.

**Example workflow:**
1. User navigates to...
2. User clicks on...
3. System displays...

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 👥 Use Case

**Who would benefit from this feature?**
- [ ] Healthcare professionals (doctors, nurses, etc.)
- [ ] Medical researchers
- [ ] Medical students
- [ ] System administrators
- [ ] Other: ___________

**How would they use it?**

Describe a real-world scenario where this feature would be valuable.

## 📊 Impact

**Priority (from your perspective):**
- [ ] Critical - Blocks important workflows
- [ ] High - Significantly improves user experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor enhancement

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups (Optional)

If you have wireframes, mockups, or examples from other applications, please share them here.

## 🛠️ Technical Considerations (Optional)

If you have technical knowledge, feel free to suggest:
- Which components would be affected
- Potential implementation approach
- Any technical challenges you foresee

## 📚 Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## 🤝 Contribution

Would you be interested in contributing to the implementation of this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I can help with implementation
- [ ] Yes, I can help with testing
- [ ] Yes, I can help with documentation
- [ ] No, but I'm happy to provide feedback
